approval.approved_statement: Peter requested installation of the latest consolidated Pi version and selected this same Core owner for the bounded rc.6 contract. This protected exact-candidate process binds that scope to the qualified source, consumer and published profile bytes; it is not a claim that the earlier human message named these later hashes.

constraints: This candidate is not dispatch authority until exact independent review, applicable Owner Authorization, protected Core source and distinct Finalization with actual canonical qualification are read back.

Use only these versioned artifact identities and protected SHA256 values. GitHub native immutable is false; no repository-enforced immutability or availability guarantee is claimed. Downloaded bytes and publication provenance must match on each use.
Use the qualified rc.6 consumer and closed inventory. Verify fresh fixed configuration, negotiated ed25519 fingerprint, hostname, complete model, architecture and device profile before each mutation.
Serialize each physical instance; no automatic retry, failover, destructive rollback, credential or sudo change, or inferred cancellation.
Preserve configuration, pairing, server Profile, previous release and recovery evidence. No pairing reset, Profile selection, HA repair or broader target is authorized here.
Readiness, deployment and separate matching smoke remain per instance. Overall operational success requires both actual current successful deployment and smoke joins.

Core prepares the producer binding only. The Pi owner retains current per-instance execution and readiness gates; this is not installed, physical touch, native, live Session, audio or user acceptance.
